a Tests row for a test not written yet.is passed over quietly when it names a file not there yet, and still named when a written test is missing
traceForward, after a cited spec is renamed.still lists what cites the renamed spec's criterion, and says it is missing; current at the citing commit
traceForward, from a node whose source-path is a list.reaches the files under every path in the list
traceForward, where a line names an artifact in code rather than a comment.reaches the comments that cite it and never the string that names it

traceForward, where git cannot read part of the repository.names a search of the history it could not run as the repository's, and still lists the code's citations

traceForward.gives a spec every position of each of its criteria
traceForward.gives an architecture node the files under its source path that no nested node claims, as recorded
traceForward.lists a criterion's positions: the commits citing it, and the tests its Tests table names; suspect once it changed
traceForward.lists every position that cites an ADR, in the code and in commits, each with how it is known
traceForward.names a source it cannot read, and still answers
